_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description: a partial tag failure is visible and retry preserves existing tags. Conversations {{FIRST}} (slug {{FIRST_SLUG}}) and {{SECOND}} are tagged tagfail. The test fails the second request to set tags with a 500 "bulk tag failure" and lets the others through; call "tag-requests" counts them all. Call "after-failure" checks that exactly one request succeeded and that the conversation it was for is tagged exactly tagfail and tagfail-added while the other is still tagged just tagfail, returning "ok" or what is wrong. Call "tags" returns the sorted tags of each conversation by name (first, second). Conversation rows are ".conversation-item[data-conversation-id='<id>']" ("the row of <id>"), and "the check" of a row is its ".drawer-selection-check" checkbox; whether a checkbox "is checked" is an eval of its .checked (polled with expect). "The visible rows" are the elements matching ".drawer .conversation-item" with "visible": true. "The status" is ".drawer-bulk-status" and "the selection count" is ".drawer-bulk-count". To "open the search at P": navigate to P, click the button "Open conversations", click the button "Search conversations...", then wait for ".drawer-search-input" to be visible. To "select the N matches": click the button "Select conversations", click the checkbox named exactly "Select all N matching conversations" (role checkbox), then check that the selection count reads exactly "N selected". The search query editor is the contenteditable element with data-testid "conversation-query-editor" ("the editor"); its data-query-value attribute is the serialized query. "The query is X" means data-query-value is exactly X, spaces included. To "set the query to X": eval the editor's focus(), press_key "a" with modifiers "Control" (the editor's own select-all), insert_text X (as pasting would), then wait until the query is X. To "clear the query": eval the editor's focus(), press_key "a" with modifiers "Control", press Backspace, then wait until the query is "". Query tokens are [data-conversation-query-token="<kind>"] elements inside the editor (kind tag or user); "the token T" is the one whose text contains T. Every selector you need is given here, so do not explore the source code or read other tests (the old Playwright spec is being replaced and does not apply): write all the steps in one run_steps call right away, and look something up only if a step fails. Perform the numbered steps in order, each fully. A button "X" is {"role": "button", "name": "X", "exact": true}, with a "selector" to scope it when it is a row's, a menu's or a group's; but "there is no button X" counts {"role": "button", "name": "X"} without exact, so that a name containing X counts too. Texts that "are exactly [...]" are checked with assert_texts. "There is no S", "no S" or "none" means no element matches at all: assert_count 0, never a visibility check. Whether an element "has the class X" is an eval of its classList.contains('X') (polled with expect), never a visibility check: a collapsed drawer may have no size. 1. Open the search at /c/{{FIRST_SLUG}}. 2. Set the query to "tag:tagfail ". 3. Select the 2 matches. 4. Click the button "Tag selected conversations". 5. Fill the input labelled "New tag" (role textbox, exact name) with "tagfail-added". 6. Click the button "Apply tags". 7. ".drawer-row-error" contains "bulk tag failure". 8. The status reads exactly "Tags updated on 1 of 2 conversations". 9. The selection count reads exactly "2 selected". 10. Call "tag-requests" with expect "2". 11. Call "after-failure" with expect "ok". 12. The checks of the rows of {{FIRST}} and {{SECOND}} are checked. 13. The button "Apply tags" is enabled. 14. Click the button "Apply tags". 15. The status reads exactly "Tags updated on 2 conversations". 16. There is no ".drawer-row-error". 17. Call "tags" with expect '{"first":["tagfail","tagfail-added"],"second":["tagfail","tagfail-added"]}'.
